source: Hand-written (01_decisions_log, 18 Nov 'explore mode: conversion data and shortlist heuristic'; rules R1-R9 confirmed 19 Nov). Read by engine/explore.py and engine-ts/src/explore.ts.
url_note: The 18 Nov draft with source URLs was given in a chat and is not in the repo; url is null where the decisions log names the source but not its link. Fill them before the explore page ships.

solar_land_ha_per_mw.source: low: CTUIL advisory on benchmark cost and land (Sep 2026, sourced); central: HAREDA private solar park guidelines minimum (Feb 2022, verify); high: MNRE solar park scheme (verify)

solar_capex_cr_per_mw.source: CTUIL advisory (Sep 2026, sourced; a compliance benchmark, not a market price); high: CERC order of 26 Dec 2025, NGEL 40 MW Ayodhya, via trade press (verify)

wind_turbine_mw.source: Low end of an NTPC tender's 2.7-3.6 MW range

farm_digester_m3d.source: Size range of community/farm digesters; low = smallest unit worth certifying

ar_plantation_cost_inr_per_ha.source: Odisha State CAMPA APO 2025-26 (1,000 and 1,600 plants/ha models); high: DTE, 4 Mar 2025 (Rs 5-8 lakh/ha range in a state draft)

ar_mangrove_cost_inr_per_ha.source: Odisha State CAMPA APO 2025-26 (2,500 plants/ha incl. fishbone channels); low: Green India Mission 2014 norm (stale)

minimum_units.source: A size below these is unlikely to cover fixed registration and validation costs (18 Nov; revisit after the certification-cost step)

no_ccts_route.solar_pv: BM EN01.001 p6 para 9 (standalone grid-connected solar excluded)
no_ccts_route.wind_onshore: BM EN01.001 p6 para 9 (standalone onshore wind excluded)
no_ccts_route.centralised_digester: BM AG04.001 p3 para 5(a) (households or small farms only)

blockers.budget_below_min_unit: Budget band is below the smallest unit worth certifying
blockers.forest_land_expert_check: Land that was managed forest in the last 10 years needs an expert check under VM0047 (v1.1 p12, 4.4.1(1))
blockers.manure_baseline_unknown: Depends on how manure is stored today: solid storage, daily spread or dung cakes fail AMS-III.D (p3 para 3(d)) and GS AWMS (3.2.2)
blockers.wind_resource_study: Needs a wind resource study; land area says nothing about wind
blockers.timeline_miss: Typical time to first credits is longer than the timeline you gave
blockers.ccts_obligated_check: If the site's owner is a CCTS obligated entity, the CCTS offset route is closed (BM IN02.001 p3 para 2)
blockers.land_rights_not_checked: Community or government land: this tool does not check who can sign for the land or the carbon rights
blockers.additionality_grid_solar: Grid solar is often profitable without carbon revenue, so it is the most likely to fail additionality
blockers.mangrove_no_estimate: No credits estimate for mangroves without site data
blockers.size_needs_site_data: Credits can't be sized from land or budget; needs site data
blockers.ccts_no_issuance_history: CCTS has no issuance history yet, so time to first credits is unknown

not_shortlisted.no_ccts_route_for_buyer: No open CCTS route for this technology, and the buyer is domestic
not_shortlisted.no_site_for_grid_re: No land suited to ground-mounted solar, and the budget can't reach one wind turbine
not_shortlisted.no_industrial_site: No industrial site using fuel or power

access_fit.landfill_gas: Has a landfill or waste contract
access_fit.industrial_ee_fs: Has an industrial site using fuel or power

rank_basis: Heuristic, not an eligibility check: access answered > budget reaches the smallest unit > typical time to first credits vs your timeline > fewer blockers > fixed sector order
caveat: Projects that are profitable without carbon revenue may fail additionality, which this tool does not screen.
caveats: Shortlist is a heuristic, not an eligibility check. Pick an item to run the full check.
